title: Happiness Is So Close!
original_title: Ah que le bonheur est proche !
overview: Jean-Luc, an actor in his 80s, is thrilled. He’s been offered the role of Don Quixote in a contemporary adaptation of Cervantes’s work. It’s the big role he’s been waiting for to bid farewell to the stage. But his age-related health issues are making rehearsals difficult.
